source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

conventions.RESOLVE: Not stated in the catalogue summary this registry was built from. Must be read off the original paper. Deliberately NOT guessed - a wrong log base, component definition or magnitude scale is a silent factor-of-two class of error.
conventions.approximate: true where Douglas qualifies the range. Indicative, not a boundary you can defend.

coefficients.status.anchor_only: The spec appendix supplies a reproducible anchor branch (normally PGA). The spectral table still requires the original paper. No kernel is implemented yet, so the wrapper still refuses.
coefficients.status.partial: Some values are given but not enough to evaluate even the anchor branch. The gap is named in coefficients.needed.
coefficients.status.original_table_required: Equation and metadata only; no numerical coefficients in the catalogue.
coefficients.status.unavailable_by_nature: The catalogue states the coefficients are not given at all.
coefficients.status.present: params/coeffs/<model_id>.json exists with recorded provenance AND a MedianKernel is registered.

conventions.spatial_correlation: None of the 30 supplies one. Every entry is a single-site marginal - see README.md.
conventions.reproduction: Per-model completeness, from the spec appendix section 11.2. ANCHOR_BRANCH_REPRODUCIBLE does NOT mean the full spectral GMPE is reproducible: unless a period table is supplied, off-anchor periods must be refused, never interpolated from the anchor.
conventions.anchor_note: What a coefficient block implies without stating it - an unnamed site coefficient, an unnamed reference class, a horizontal branch whose component definition is not given. Recorded so the inference is visible; the field itself stays RESOLVE where the appendix is silent.
conventions.aleatory: Published variability, in the model's OWN log base. Naming follows each source: some give tau/phi, some a single total sigma, Bindi gives event/station, Hong adds an orientation term. Do not normalise these onto one vocabulary.

boore-atkinson-2008.label: Boore & Atkinson (2008)

site.anchor_note: Nonlinear site parameters blin/b1/b2 and a1/a2/pga_low are given for PGA.

coefficients.needed: The period-dependent SPECTRAL table for FM(M), FD(Rjb,M), FLIN and FNL. The PGA anchor coefficients (e1-e7, c1-c3, h, blin, b1, b2, Mh, Vref) and tau/phi are now available from the spec appendix; the spectral table is not.

implementation_notes: Piecewise magnitude scaling about a hinge magnitude.
Nonlinear site term requires reference-rock PGA computed internally.
Long-period coefficients rest on far fewer records than short-period ones.
boore-atkinson-2008.reason_for_inclusion: NGA anchor; nonlinear Vs30 site response.

idriss-2008.label: Idriss (2008)

magnitude.note: alpha1/alpha2 switch at Mw 6.75: 3.7066/-0.1252 below, 5.6315/-0.4104 above.

site.note: A correction applies for Vs30 > 900 m/s. This is not a continuous nonlinear site model - do not generalise it into one.

mechanism.note: A single fault-style term phi(T)*F in the published equation.
mechanism.anchor_note: A single fault-style flag F with coefficient 0.12. Which classes F encodes is still not stated.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; Idriss (2008) has no OpenQuake implementation (only idriss_2014.py) and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

idriss-2008.equation: ln(PSA) = alpha1(T) + alpha2(T)*M - [beta1(T) + beta2(T)*M]*ln(Rrup + 10) + gamma(T)*Rrup + phi(T)*F

coefficients.needed: The period-dependent SPECTRAL table for alpha1, alpha2, beta1, beta2, gamma and phi. PGA/headline values, the magnitude break, the sigma expression and the high-Vs30 correction are now available.

implementation_notes: Magnitude-dependent sigma with clipping magnitudes.
Test above and below the magnitude breakpoint and around Vs30 = 900 m/s.
idriss-2008.sigma_rule: 1.28 + 0.05*ln(T) - 0.08*M, capped at M=5 and M=7.5; for T<0.05 use T=0.05

chen-yu-2008a.label: Chen & Yu (2008a)

distance.note: Douglas describes a source-distance form defined in the paper. Resolve before coding; do not assume Rrup.

site.note: Douglas section 4.153: only records from sites with Vs30 >= 500 m/s are used, and the functional form has no site term. A single calibration condition, not a set of classes. Do NOT add a site-amplification model.

mechanism.anchor_note: The reproduced functional form contains no mechanism term.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; Douglas gives Ts = U (unknown number of periods). Still RESOLVE.

coefficients.needed: The whole damping-dependent coefficient set. The appendix reproduces the functional form only, explicitly NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_DOUGLAS, for all five damping ratios.

implementation_notes: Supported damping must be exactly {0.005, 0.02, 0.07, 0.10, 0.20}; never substitute 5% coefficients for an unlisted ratio.
Preserve the source magnitude-distance binning and site restrictions.
chen-yu-2008a.equation: log Sa = C1 + C2*M + C3*M^2 + C4*log[R + C5*exp(C6*M)]
chen-yu-2008a.log_base_note: The reproduced form is written 'log' with no base stated, and the appendix gives no log_base. Still unresolved.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for both components. PGA coefficients C1-C6, h0 and sigma for horizontal and vertical are now available. The magnitude scale is still not stated.

musson-1994-uk.label: Musson et al. (1994)

magnitude.note: Low-magnitude UK data; foreign supplementary records reach ~6.4. ML, NOT Mw - converting silently changes the model.

distance.note: UK records start at about 70 km; everything closer comes from the Canadian and Belgian supplementary data.

site.anchor_note: Neither PGA model carries a site term in the appendix.

periods.note: The spectral model is 5%-damped PSEUDO-VELOCITY, not acceleration.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the report is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

variants.pga: RESOLVED into two named variants: model_1 and model_2.
variants.model_1: Complete in the appendix: a = 2.11, b = 1.23, d = -0.014.
variants.model_2: INCOMPLETE: c4 = -0.0148 is given, but c1 and c2 are taken from Dahle et al. (1990b) and are not reproduced. Recommended sigma 0.65.

coefficients.needed: For model_2, c1 and c2 from Dahle et al. (1990b) - a SECOND source, not just the original paper. For the spectral branch, the 5%-damped pseudo-velocity table. Model 1's PGA coefficients are complete and available.

implementation_notes: Foreign supplemental records do not change the UK regional applicability label.
Distinguish low-magnitude UK tests from the larger foreign-supported range, keeping extrapolation warnings separate.

reproduction.incomplete_note: Partial: PGA model 1 is reproducible; model 2 depends on coefficients from Dahle et al. (1990b) that the appendix does not reproduce.

resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax '>477.4 (200*)' -- UK data beyond 477.4 km, foreign records to ~200 km
resolution_provenance.distance.approximate: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): values starred / bounded

musson-1994-uk.component_note: Still RESOLVE. Douglas (2011) codes the component U (unknown); its footnote records only that Free (1996) 'believes it is largest horizontal component'. That is a third party's belief, not the authors' statement.

lussou-2001.label: Lussou et al. (2001)

magnitude.note: JMA magnitude, not Mw. Converting silently changes the model.

site.note: Derived from measured/extrapolated Vs30, so the mapping is published. Honour the boundaries exactly.
site.anchor_note: All four classes carry published PGA coefficients: A 0.617, B 0.721, C 0.845, D 0.891.

published_grid_summary.note: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) gives the count and range only; no OpenQuake implementation and the paper is not openly available. Still RESOLVE.

lussou-2001.equation: log PSA(f) = a(f)*M + b(f)*R - log(R) + c(site_class, f)

coefficients.needed: The frequency-dependent a(f), b(f) and per-class c(f) table. PGA coefficients (a 0.371, b -0.00254, c per class A-D, sigma 0.313) are now available. The magnitude scale is still not stated.

implementation_notes: The published equation is written 'log' without a stated base. RESOLVE whether log10 or ln before coding.
Test at every Vs30 class boundary and at both magnitude and distance extremes.
lussou-2001.reason_for_inclusion: Smaller-event Japanese model with measured site velocities.
lussou-2001.log_base_note: Resolved: the appendix states log_base 10, settling the ambiguity in the 'log PSA(f)' form.
